question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the given figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01676b925c57ae4dc147051c57cb5859357f28a50874aea30b6ef1e0e0e82f62.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Number in circle = [2 **× **(first number in the quadrilateral) × (second number in the quadrilateral) ] + 1

In figure 1:

41 = [2 ×** **(4) × (5) ] + 1

41 = 40 + 1

In figure 2: 

85 = [2 × (6) × (7) ] + 1

85 = 84 + 1

Similarly in figure 3:

⇒ [2 × (8) × (9) ] + 1

⇒ 144 + 1

⇒145

Hence, 145 is the correct answer.
